Hypothesis worth testing before any run: cells reached PBO with a single surviving candidate, making overfitting unprovable by construction. The 128->300 attempt widening in 47e4c33 enlarges that pool. Question for you: instrument one cell end-to-end and report the actual (T observations, N candidates) matrix shape arriving at cscv_pbo, and which upstream filter collapses N. Do not fix anything yet - report the shape first.

TWO CHALLENGES, both change what gets built. Q1: does the canary return a PBO VERDICT or only a shape? _cell_pbo_evidence returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE on N<min and T<min before computing anything, so one EURUSD|D1 cell may satisfy both minima and still generalise nothing, because relative_rank divides by (N-1). If the canary can only yield T and N, say so and name the smallest run that returns an actual PASS/FAIL - CPM would rather spend the same wall clock on 6-10 symbols producing verdicts than one cell producing a shape. Q2: N=2. Winner policy pins pbo_min_evaluation_candidates=2; config pins false_discovery_pbo_min_candidates=5; and classify_promotion_status:2443 reads the CONFIG path's pbo_status while CX-019 says the authority path is the WINNER one. Two contracts, two minima, promotion reading the one you call non-authoritative. CPM position: both 2 and 5 are statistically inert for CSCV; binding minimum N>=20, and below it a cell must report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never PASS. If you accept, the 300 widening becomes REQUIRED and CPM upgrades item 3 to KEEP. If you reject, the widening loses its last justification and should revert to 128 pending a completed run. CPM will not rule on item 3 without your answer. Third defect for the record: CAUSAL_FOLD_COUNT 4 x CAUSAL_FOLD_MIN_DAYS 63 = 252 exactly equals pbo_min_observations 252 - zero slack, one short fold returns ALIGNED_DAILY_MATRIX_TOO_SHORT for the whole cell. Task 13 WFV split audit is complete and CLEAN - the operator named backtester/WFV as leaky in the version that nearly passed a funded challenge, and this was the last unexamined mechanism. build_calendar_boundaries (pm_evidence.py:299) orders windows strictly backwards from the cutoff with a purge at both seams, negative embargo clamped, so training is entirely older than tuning and cannot see it. The purge is max(7 days, 5min x split_embargo_bars) = 7 days TIMEFRAME-AGNOSTIC, which looked like the defect because the label horizon is timeframe-dependent and 39/132 promoted cells are H4 with 16 D1. It is not a defect: pm_core.py:1227 force-closes any open position at window end as EXIT_EOD, so NO TRADE SPANS A SEAM and no training label can depend on validation prices. Feature lookback through the purge into train is legitimate - that history exists live. Residual only: each window's last open trade exits at an arbitrary price. Combined with E14 the leak search is exhausted in the current engine; the reproduced failure mechanism is selection bias on thin samples, not look-ahead. This removes a whole class of doubt from the run you are about to instrument.

BUT one of these is not neutral and I will not rule on it alone: pm_native_storage holds the retention/collectability graph (protect_tree), and register E5 established it has zero shipping references - which is the mechanical cause of the 25 GiB data/native and the 15.5 GiB unpruned spool. CPM proposes: (a) delete the four zero-reference modules and their tests in one freeze after persisting blobs, EXCEPT pm_native_storage; (b) rule separately on pm_native_storage as wire-in-or-delete; (c) defer the four with 1-2 refs until those references are traced, since a single reference may be a live consumer or may itself be dead. Nothing is deleted until XPM rules and until it cannot collide with your L-0009 canary work.
